compilation.subtitle: Describe the video you want: the AI builds it from passages of the live, and you keep talking to it to adjust it. You can also search for passages by hand and put them together yourself.
compilation.name: Compilation name
compilation.searchHint: Words: what is said in the live or written in the chat, free and instant. The AI searches by meaning ("the moments when it kicks off"): it digs through the live, listens to passages and checks each one before answering.

compilation.briefPlaceholder: E.g. first every time someone says it's calm, then when it kicks off, then when I lose it.
compilation.describeHint: The AI looks in the live for the passages of each part, checks them, then proposes the video. Tell it the layout you want too ("my cam on top, the game below"): it picks the template closest to it. Everything stays editable afterwards.
compilation.aiReading: It checks every passage before answering: give it 15 to 60 seconds.

compilation.onlyNear_other: Nothing that really matches: {{count}} close passages
compilation.nearTitle: Close to what you are after without really being it: the AI says what is missing.

find.title: Search the whole live
find.text: Type a word or an idea. "$t(compilation.searchWords)" finds what is said or written in the chat: free and instant. "$t(compilation.askAi)" searches by meaning, when no precise word fits.

ai.title: The AI searches like an editor
ai.text: It digs through what is said, the chat, the sounds and the analysis's best moments, then listens to the passages to check them. Give it 15 to 30 seconds and less than a cent. The first question on a live takes 2 to 3 minutes: Cuttie listens to the whole of it, once.

results.title: It tells you what it found
results.text: Its note says what really matches. A "≈ $t(compilation.nearTag)" passage looks like what you asked for without quite being it. Click a passage to watch it, "+" to keep it.

build.title: Build your video
build.text: Sort your passages into parts, change the order, trim them, then fit the length you want. Faster: "$t(compilation.tab.describe)", and the AI proposes the parts and their passages. Everything stays editable.

sample.query: the moments when it kicks off
sample.wordsHint: said or written in the chat
sample.firstTime: 1st time on a live: 2 to 3 min
sample.note: The shootout really matches. The fall is only close.
sample.sureText: Watch out, they're shooting! Take cover!
sample.sureWhy: A shootout breaks out in front of the hospital
sample.nearText: I slipped a bit, I'm fine…

about.phonk: Fast beat, strong synth bass. For action, kills and best-ofs.
about.phonk2: Steady drive and heavy bass. For big moments and action compilations.
about.phonk3: Distorted bass, fast beat, intense mood. For highlights and tense gameplay.
about.hiphop: Instrumental hip-hop at a brisk tempo, lively drums. For big plays and best-ofs.
about.stream: Laid-back electronic with airy synths. For conversations as well as an evening's highlights.
about.vlog: Easy-going hip-hop with scratches. For conversations and offbeat moments.
about.synthwave: Lively retro synthwave. For highlights, skill, or under a conversation.
about.chiptune: Fast chiptune with retro sounds. For funny moments and gaming highlights.
about.pixel: Catchy chiptune with a steady beat. For relaxed play and gameplay sequences.
about.retro: Fast, cheerful 8-bit. For funny moments and compilations.
about.lofi: Relaxed lofi, light drums, airy synths. For conversations.
about.lofi2: Laid-back lofi with light synths. For conversations and quiet moments.
about.chill: Slow, soft lo-fi that stays far back. For conversations and calm play.
about.tension: Slow, bare electronic with synth pads. To build tension or sit under a calm conversation.
about.tension2: Muted electronic, light drums, synth pads. For tense moments and quiet storytelling.
about.grave: Grave, tense atmosphere with minimal drums. For suspense and calm moments.
about.suspense: Dark synths and driving drums. For suspense and plays where everything is at stake.
about.trap: Energetic trap with punchy synths. For highlights and big plays.
about.sneaky: Bouncy beat and mischievous synths, meme style. For funny moments and fails.
about.quirky: Playful piano and light drums. For funny moments and relaxed conversations.

soundAi.ai: Music and intro by the AI
soundAi.working: The AI is choosing the music and the intro…
soundAi.hint: It looks at what kind of video this is (funny, skill, calm…) and chooses the music and the intro that go with it, or none. It starts from your favourites (My channel).

compilation.planCached: Same description as a time before: the AI gave its answer again, at no cost. “Ask again” has it search anew.
compilation.keptAnswer: An answer from a time before: the AI searched nothing and spent nothing.
compilation.askAgainHint: The AI searches anew, as if you asked for the first time. The new answer replaces this one.

dress.label: Look and sound
dress.hint: The AI looks at the video and chooses each passage's template, the transition, the intro and the music. It starts from your favourites (My channel).

briefFor.clip: E.g. around 3 h in, I step out of the seaplane and die in the propeller.
briefFor.sequence: E.g. the yacht mission, from the jet-ski arrival to the airboat escape.

compilations.title: Compilations
compilations.subtitle: Videos made of passages of a live: describe what you want, the AI builds it, you adjust.
compilations.described: Built by describing it to the AI
compilations.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" and its cut passages will be deleted.
compilations.deleteExported: "{{name}}" and its cut passages will be deleted. The video already exported stays in Exports.
compilations.newHint: Describe the video you want, the AI builds it from passages of the live.
compilations.pickLiveHint: Tick one live, or several for a video that draws on all of them: the AI then works on all at once.
compilations.noLiveHint: A compilation is made of passages of a live. Analyse a live, then come back here.
compilations.notAnalysedHint: To take passages from a live, it has to be analysed first. It isn't free: {{cost}} of OpenRouter credits per live.
compilations.analysePrice: Analysing this live takes {{cost}} of OpenRouter credits, and from a few minutes to over an hour depending on its length and your computer. It runs in the background: the live will show up in the list once ready.
compilations.analyseStarted: Analysis started ({{cost}}). The live will show up here as soon as it is done.
compilations.analysed: “{{name}}” is analysed: you can pick it.
compilations.deleteEverywhere_one: It is made from {{count}} lives: it will be gone from each of them.
compilations.deleteEverywhere_other: It is made from {{count}} lives: it will be gone from each of them.

suggestions.aboutSequence: {{span}} in a row in the live (at {{at}}) · a video of about {{length}}

suggestions.about_one: A video of about {{length}} · {{count}} moment spotted
suggestions.about_other: A video of about {{length}} · {{count}} moments spotted
suggestions.buildHint: The AI looks for the passages and puts the video together: {{cost}}, 30 to 45 s. You then change it as you like.

suggestions.noticed: What I noticed in your live:
suggestions.dismissMessage: “{{name}}” will no longer be proposed for this live.
suggestions.foundHint: Videos the AI spotted in this live: open one and it builds it.
suggestions.waiting_one: {{count}} compilation proposed by the AI to discover
suggestions.waiting_other: {{count}} compilations proposed by the AI to discover
suggestions.toast_one: The AI proposes {{count}} compilation for this live
suggestions.toast_other: The AI proposes {{count}} compilations for this live
suggestions.findHint: It goes through the whole live (what comes back, what repeats, the stories it tells) and proposes compilations to make. Under a cent, about 30 s.
suggestions.finding: The AI is going through the live…
suggestions.looking: The AI is looking for compilation ideas in this live…
suggestions.nothingNew: The AI has nothing new to propose for this live

memory.title: The AI's memory
memory.hint: What it remembers of your streams. It writes it on its own; you can correct it.

section.stories: What goes on from one stream to the next

memory.empty: The AI hasn't read a stream yet. It will read the next one once it is analysed.
memory.emptyUnread: The AI remembers nothing yet: have it read the streams you already analysed.

memory.unread_other: {{count}} analysed streams it hasn't read yet

memory.resumedDone: The AI will read each stream once analysed

proposal.from: The AI, after reading your streams
proposal.title: Is your note “{{title}}” still true?
proposal.ignored: Understood, the note stays as it is
proposal.changed: Your note changed in the meantime: nothing was modified
proposal.failed: The note could not be changed

videos.title: Videos
videos.subtitle: Three ways to get a video out of a live: one moment, a stretch in a row, or passages from all over.

about.clip: One moment of the live, about a minute.
about.sequence: A stretch in a row (a mission, a situation that lasts), told as one video.
about.compilation: Passages from all over the live, or from several lives.

newHint.clip: Describe the moment, even roughly (“around 3 h in, this happened…”): the AI finds it and cuts it.
newHint.sequence: Say which stretch to tell: the AI keeps its beats, in order.
newHint.compilation: Describe the video: the AI builds it from the live's passages.

changeFor.clip: E.g. “cut the beginning”, “also keep what happens right after”. Enter to send.
changeFor.sequence: E.g. “shorten the middle part”, “add the end of the mission”. Enter to send.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.empty: Open a video in Edit: searching the live and asking the AI for a change happen here.
